newsitem.title: USA: Homeowners Group extends merger pact.
newsitem.headline: Homeowners Group extends merger pact.

text.p: Homeowners Group Inc said Wednesday it amended its agreement to merge with privately-held Cross Country Group Inc, allowing the agreement to be in effect through July 31.
The companies will continue negotiations in an attempt to agree to further modifications, Homeowners Group said.
The agremeent would have expired on July 1, before the latest amendment, the third, was agreed to by the parties.

On June 13, Homeowners Group, a provider of goods and services to the real estate industry, said Cross Country had notified it that it would not proceed with the proposed merger because Homeowners Group faces a $7 million tax bill from the U.S. Internal Revenue Service.
Homeowners said it is contesting the IRS assessment and would discuss modifications of the merger agreement with Cross Country.
Cross Country, based in Boston, provides roadside assistance, insurance claim reporting, address change and moving-related services, and emergency home repair assistance.
